Nora: FYI we received an RFP from OrionPay. They want a 3-week POC, customer-managed HSM (Thales preferred), and an on-prem footprint with audit logging and signed DPA. Attaching questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/orionpay-rfp
Ethan: I can run the POC. Ask for: target throughput (qps), sample prompts, and evaluation rubric. Also confirm whether they accept a Dedicated trial first?
Rhea: SE notes  Private supports Thales/Azure HSM via KMIP/keywrap. If Thales firmware <3.2 we need a shim. For Dedicated (hosted) we can do KMS only with a VPN/PrivateLink and SecOps approval. Will draft HSM compatibility table for the RFI.
Sam: Pricing options to propose: 1) 3-week Dedicated trial (discounted reserved capacity)  est $10k; 2) On-prem POC (license + setup)  est $48k + infra. HSM integration PS estimate $8k. I ll include these as line items.
Nora: Security team asks if we can complete their questionnaire by Thursday. @LegalBot any DPA concerns?
[LegalBot]: DPA review required. For on-prem deployments SLA clauses and incident notification windows will need edits. Recommend Legal review the attached questionnaire.
Ethan: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) 95th pct latency < 300ms at their target load; 2) Quality agreement >= 92% on 300 labeled prompts; 3) KMS key rotate success and audit log access verified. I ll prepare load scripts and a small eval harness.
Rhea: I ll attach: smoke curl, KV cache warmup script, wrk wrapper for load, HSM firmware checklist, and a network topology sample.
Nora: Action items: Rhea -> HSM checklist + attachments; Ethan -> POC test plan + scripts; Sam -> pricing table; LegalBot -> DPA review. I'll assemble RFI and send draft by Wed. Thanks :thumbsup:
[upload-bot]: OrionPay_RFP_Attachments_v1.xlsx uploaded to shared folder (link above)
